tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search lvlltd.com x402 skill catalog. Free. Returns price + free_eval URLs.

tools.name: get_skill_details
tools.description: Public skill details + outline/sample/challenge links. Free.

tools.name: get_payment_challenge
tools.description: Live x402 402 challenge for a skill. Does not unlock. Pay then purchase_skill.

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: Alias of get_payment_challenge — live x402 quote (amount, payTo, asset). Free. Full catalog.

tools.name: list_all_skills
tools.description: Paginated full catalog listing (all public skills from catalog.json — not a subset). Free.

tools.name: purchase_skill
tools.description: Without tx_hash: payment_required 402 payload. With tx_hash: POST unlock via existing /api/pay (no payment bypass).

tools.name: verify_skill
tools.description: Alias of verify_unlock — check public /api/proof ledger for confirmed unlocks (never invents volume).

tools.name: install
tools.description: Alias of install_skill_payload — after purchase write sealed files + SKILL.md paths. Requires tx_hash.

tools.name: get_commerce_signals
tools.description: Rank skills by confirmed unlock demand. Free.

tools.name: lookup_agent_identity
tools.description: ERC-8004 / local identity lookup for a wallet. Additive — not required to buy.

tools.name: quote_skill
tools.description: Alias of quote_price / get_payment_challenge — live x402 quote. Free.

tools.name: verify_unlock
tools.description: Check public /api/proof ledger for confirmed unlocks (never invents volume).

tools.name: get_security_scan
tools.description: Published security scan for a skill (real findings or clean-with-honesty). Free.

tools.name: get_eval_score
tools.description: Public eval suite pass rate if suite exists. Free.

tools.name: install_skill_payload
tools.description: After purchase: sealed files + SKILL.md install paths. Requires tx_hash (routes through /api/pay).

tools.name: intent_search
tools.description: Natural-language goal → ranked skills/stacks (semantic TF-IDF). Free.

tools.name: list_recurring_plans
tools.description: List catalog live / update / bundle-renew / metered plans. One-time unlocks remain separate and perpetual. Free.

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Resolve skill access: one_time_unlock (perpetual) > catalog_sub > bundle_renew > meter. Never confuses live access with sealed ownership.

tools.name: subscribe_plan
tools.description: Without tx_hash: 402 challenge for a plan. With tx_hash: start/renew. Cancel: action=cancel (one step). Never revokes one-time unlocks.

tools.name: a2a_discover
tools.description: A2A bridge: fetch the marketplace Agent Card (/.well-known/agent-card.json). Free. Use before a2a_message_send.

tools.name: a2a_message_send
tools.description: A2A bridge: send message/send to the LVL A2A agent. Supports multi-turn via task_id+context_id. Does not settle payment — use purchase_skill / x402 for money.

tools.name: a2a_tasks_get
tools.description: A2A bridge: tasks/get — poll stored multi-turn task by id.

tools.name: a2a_tasks_cancel
tools.description: A2A bridge: tasks/cancel — cancel an in-flight multi-turn task.

tools.name: a2a_bridge_info
tools.description: A2A↔MCP bridge topology for LVL: when to use A2A vs MCP vs x402. Free.

tools.name: meter_budget
tools.description: Get or set spend cap; or quote metered per-call x402 for a skill. Caps prevent runaway agent spend.

tools.name: esp_discover
tools.description: ESP protocol root (Evaluate → Settle → Prove). Free. Philosophy + endpoints + canary. Prefer before settling any skill.

tools.name: esp_cycle
tools.description: Full ESP cycle for a skill: free evaluate endpoints, atomic settle challenge, public prove stats (ledger-only quality). Free to call.

tools.name: esp_evaluate
tools.description: ESP Evaluate phase only — free outline/sample/canary links. Never requires payment. Settle only after this.

tools.name: sco_discover
tools.description: SCO protocol root (Sealed Consensus Oracles). Free. Philosophy, foundation oracles, agent sequence. Prefer before oracle settlement.

tools.name: sco_eval
tools.description: SCO free evaluation for an oracle: outline, free samples, ledger-only reputation. Never requires payment.

tools.name: sco_canary
tools.description: Parallel multi-provider canary: seal challengeable packs from independent oracle providers.

tools.name: sco_consensus
tools.description: Critic/consensus oracle: aggregate sealed pack cids into a higher-confidence sealed consensus pack.

tools.name: sco_challenge
tools.description: File or resolve an economic challenge against a sealed SCO pack. Reputation updates from ledger only.

tools.name: sco_reputation
tools.description: Ledger-derived oracle reputation only (accuracy, freshness, challenge_survival, selection_rate, economic_weight). Null when no evidence.

tools.name: list_judges
tools.description: Recursive evaluator market — judge/verifier/critic ESP skills. Quality from public proof ledger only. Free.

tools.name: post_intent
tools.description: Post a root problem/intent with success_criteria and optional bounty_usd (P1). Free to post. Settlement still x402; success only via /api/proof.

tools.name: get_ready
tools.description: Truthful readiness probe (/api/ready). ready:true only when payment+catalog rails work.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Public confirmed-only unlock ledger. Never invents volume. Optional skill_id filter.

tools.name: get_fleet
tools.description: Fleet map: skills, open-market, music, swarm, studio bridges. Free.

tools.name: get_sandbox
tools.description: Sandbox/execution patterns for purchased packs. Optional skill_id for per-skill resources + packaging maturity.

tools.name: get_networks
tools.description: Multi-chain + multi-asset + gas rails. Base live; other chains planned. Sponsored canary honesty.

tools.name: get_escrow_meta
tools.description: Open-market multi-party escrow (NOT skill payTo). LVLEscrow held-fund contract metadata.

tools.name: get_capability_info
tools.description: Short-lived capability token discovery (P1). Not an API key for purchase.

tools.name: get_pack_meta
tools.description: Public sealed pack metadata + sealed_pack_hash (no paywall contents).

tools.name: receipt_verify
tools.description: Verify a lvl-decision-receipt-v1 integrity hash. Returns match + recomputed hash. Free.

tools.name: receipt_mint
tools.description: Mint a DecisionReceipt for an agent-side decision (same schema as access/pay). Free.

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Store a key/value in agent KV memory (namespace optional, TTL default 24h).

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Recall a value from agent KV memory by key (+ optional namespace).

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List keys in a memory namespace (prefix list when KV supports it).

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a key from agent KV memory.

tools.name: long_running_start
tools.description: Start a long-running / background task (KV queue stub). Returns task_id for status/cancel.

tools.name: long_running_status
tools.description: Get status of a long-running task by task_id.

tools.name: long_running_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a long-running task by task_id.

tools.name: event_register
tools.description: Register interest in a topic (stub event bus). Returns event_id.

tools.name: event_list
tools.description: List active event registrations for a topic.

tools.name: event_trigger
tools.description: Trigger an event on a topic with optional payload (records + surfaces registrations).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_skills · Private data: install, lookup_agent_identity, install_skill_payload, sco_challenge, get_capability_info, event_trigger · Public sink: purchase_skill, a2a_message_send, post_intent · Destructive: get_eval_score, sco_eval, memory_forget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_skills · Private data: install, lookup_agent_identity, install_skill_payload, sco_challenge, get_capability_info, event_trigger · Public sink: purchase_skill, a2a_message_send, post_intent · Destructive: get_eval_score, sco_eval, memory_forget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
